verdicts.reason: A reads as a proper left-to-right banner with the can kept at a strong size, but the tiny SOLSTICE logo floats at x≈118 off the quote's left edge, the quote text is jammed about 18px from the left canvas edge, and there is a big dead gap between the quote mark and the text. B shrinks the can to a trivial thumbnail with an unreadable label and a nearly lost sun icon, centres the logo on an axis the indented text block doesn't share, and leaves a large empty left third, so the product is buried and the balance is lopsided.
